svg.title: Step 6: timeline, site facts and export
svg.desc: Step 6: timeline, site facts and export
svg.text: Timeline: Sun up (amber), Earth link, Sun dark, Earth outage. The white line is the chosen time.
Zoom and pan the timeline to see a single day.
Export: copy a link to this exact view, or download CSV, PNG and a summary.
Site facts, the terrain warning, and an Open in QuickMap link for a cross-check.
